verdict.rationale: Mangopay's API-first wallet infrastructure lets a platform build balance and payout views inside its own product, since it can create and hold funds in wallets and run payouts to users' bank accounts. It also ships an embeddable pre-built UI component for recipient bank-account registration, and its checkout SDK has design elements customizable to your branding. However, there is no evidence of embeddable seller-facing components for balances, payouts or transaction history, so the developer must build those UIs on top of the raw APIs. Missing for 10: documented transaction-history/reporting API, white-label embeddable components for balances, payouts and history, independent hands-on corroboration.
